snippet.title: Dark Thoughts - The Official Gameplay Reveal Trailer for a new psychological horror bullet heaven
snippet.description:
Dark Thoughts is an indie bullet heaven where you use damaged heroes to battle the onslaught of dark thoughts that attack us daily. With 12 mentally-anguished heroes to help you conquer 9 trauma-filled levels you'll be hard pressed to stay sane throughout. But, if you do and can conquer all of the maps you'll unlock the entire Dark Thoughts album for download! 

Coming Q4 2026
Steam Next Fest Demo: October 2026

Wishlist on Steam: Coming soon
